verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents an API action to send a campaign, sending immediately or on a schedule for RSS campaigns. It also advertises email design, custom-coded templates and AI-assisted campaign creation, and a community user confirms a hands-on drag-and-drop builder. Audiences and targeting appear via audience contacts, segmentation and targeted-email features. Missing for 10: explicit docs on scheduling a regular (non-RSS) campaign for a future time, explicit evidence of choosing an audience or segment when creating a campaign, and in-depth first-party docs on the campaign composer.
